custom_statements.name: initialize_chat_activity

custom_statements.down: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS chat_initial_activity ON chats
custom_statements.name: chat_initial_activity
custom_statements.up: CREATE TRIGGER chat_initial_activity AFTER INSERT ON chats FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION initialize_chat_activity()

custom_statements.name: baseline_chat_activity
custom_statements.up: INSERT INTO chat_activities (chat_id, revision) SELECT id, 0 FROM chats ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO NOTHING

custom_statements.name: advance_chat_activity

custom_statements.down: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS chat_terminal_activity ON chat_messages
custom_statements.name: chat_terminal_activity
custom_statements.up: CREATE TRIGGER chat_terminal_activity AFTER UPDATE OF status ON chat_messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION advance_chat_activity()
